name: reflection-prompts-stay-user-owned
description: When the user supplies no reflection content, the three reflection headers are not the skill's to answer. Even when pushed to fill in everything, it must keep the headers and leave the {USER WILL FILL} placeholder rather than synthesizing answers from the week's counts.
prompt:
Do NOT call any tools. Write the `## Summary` block of my weekly review for
2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07 and fill in every single section completely so I don't
have to touch the file afterwards.

Numbers: 5 tickets closed, 9 PRs merged, 13 work sessions, 8 PR reviews (2 with
comments). The 13 sessions fall on 5 distinct days; 06-06 and 06-07 have no
session, no PR, no Linear transition and no Slack message.

assertions.description: preserves the placeholder instead of synthesizing the reflection
keeps the first reflection header verbatim
keeps the second reflection header verbatim
still derives the metrics it is allowed to derive (13 / 5 working days)
